clarifications.change: build_x4_pack.py reads data/hfr_<state>.csv instead of the literal data/hfr_lagos.csv, so X5 can reuse it for FCT; with STATE = 'Lagos' it reads the same file and builds the same pack

known_risks: 111 of the 150 review-band pairs share a source id, and the card shows it, so those labels lean on it
the development labels come from Edo, Kano and Ondo only; Lagos is urban and may name facilities differently
the first training attempt ran in the repository's CPU-only environment and was stopped before finishing; its partial output was deleted and nothing from it was used
question: Does the pair decider settle part of the engine's review band in a state that no part of it was trained or tuned on, with errors and false merges in bound?

rule.combiner: X3's control arm: [cross-encoder logit, log1p km, LGA agree, coordinates missing], fitted on the 692 corrected development labels, thresholds from 5-fold out-of-fold predictions (x3_level.fit); no facility-level feature (X3 found no measurable gain)
rule.cross_encoder: X0's recipe (x0.examples, x0.train, seeds 0-2, same schedule) with Lagos held out together with Edo, Kano and Ondo; weights pinned below
rule.error_bound: errors among auto-decided <= 3% and Wilson 95% upper bound <= 10%
rule.false_merge_bound: different pairs auto-matched / all different pairs <= 2% and Wilson 95% upper bound <= 5%
rule.informative: void unless the test holds at least 60 different pairs
rule.pass: informative, and every seed meets fewer_held, error_bound and false_merge_bound on the whole pack
rule.population: the X4 pack (data/review_packs/nigeria_facilities_lagos_x4_2026-11-22, 240 Lagos pairs: 150 review_band, 45 lookalike, 45 near_miss) marked same_entity or different; read once, after this file
rule.reference: match-everything, scored under the same rule; it must fail
rule.review_band: reported as its own verdict: every seed meets fewer_held and error_bound on the review_band pairs alone. This is the production question: how much of what the engine holds for a person in an unseen state the decider settles
secondary: crosswalk development AUC of the retrained cross-encoder

test.blind: the reviewer sees neither the engine's decision nor the pair's kind
test.construction: data/scripts/build_x4_pack.py: 150 of the engine's 360 Lagos review pairs in salted order, one per GRID3 facility; 45 lookalike and 45 near_miss pairs built as in X3 from records not already sampled; every row 'review', no score, kind kept out of the pack; the GRID3 facility's own HFR record shown when it has one

why: every state other than Edo, Kano and Ondo was in X0's cross-encoder training, and the review bands of those three are used up
